FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: a purée of {0_adj} loosened with {1_plur} and finished with {2_plur}, nutmeg grated over. Its texture is that of potato, milder and faintly sweet.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: large blanched {0_adj} leaves, rolled tight around raw {1_adj} and minced {2_adj}, stood upright in the pot and cooked covered under a weighted plate.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} poached in {1_plur} with a stick of celery, passed through a sieve and beaten with {2_plur}. The celery cannot be tasted but keeps the purée from cloying.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {1_coll} braised in caramel and {2_plur}, with {0_coll} added halfway so they take up the sauce without falling apart. They drink it in and become the best of the dish.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: a {0_adj} flour cut with yellow {2_plur}, rained into boiling water and stirred forty minutes always the same way, then served with fresh {1_plur}.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {1_coll} brought on with stock and {2_coll} from the woods, half the {0_adj} crushed to bind and the rest left in pieces. Two textures of one ingredient, which is enough for the dish.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} quartered and smothered in {2_plur} with {1_coll} and small onions, without a drop of water — the leaves give up quite enough on their own.
